summary: Willamette NF cupola cabin built 1926 above Oakridge; sources disagree on removal or arson in 1969. Only benches remain at the top; a replacement tower stands on Warner Ridge.

facts.status_note: Cabin removed or burned in 1969 (sources differ on which); a trail guide describes only a few benches at the top

access.note: onX describes an easy gravel road to the summit that is typically unmaintained in winter and can be subject to closures; no restriction on visiting the summit was found in the sources read

visit.trail_note: Easy gravel road that onX says is typically unmaintained in winter

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A lookout was on the butte by 1919 according to a newspaper report that does not describe the structure. The cabin FFLOS and firelookout.com describe was built in 1926, so the 1919 date is an earlier lookout, not the cabin.

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on 1969: FFLOS and firelookout.com say removed, Forest Lookouts and onX say it burned after arson. The 1926 build year is consistent across all sources. The 1919 lookout's structure is undescribed. The Warner Ridge tower (about 2 miles SW) has its own record (us-or-warner-mountain); its Grass Mountain framework claim rests on firelookout.com, and the Grass Mountain record notes that sources differ on whether the frame moved. Access comes from onX, a trail app, not an agency page; no Forest Service closure notice was checked. The record's design field is null; 'D-6 cupola cabin' (FFLOS) is recorded under facts.design. No record corrections proposed.
